heldOut.about: Coderbunker's timesheet data warehouse: a PostgreSQL database built by psql scripts in sql/ (schemas api, incoming, model, audit, report, postgraphql, internal, utils) that turns Google Sheets timesheet snapshots into a model, ledger and reports, served by a Node/Express app (app.js) with PostGraphile GraphQL endpoints and a /gsuite/snapshot route calling api.snapshot_json; pgTAP xUnit test functions in sql/test run by runtests('test'), and a web3 smart-contract skeleton in to_blockchain/. Written down on 2026-11-10 from its README, code and tests before Assay first ran on it.
heldOut.stacks: PostgreSQL (PL/pgSQL, SQL, materialized views, postgres_fdw), psql scripts, pgTAP xUnit; Node.js, Express, PostGraphile, node-postgres, mocha; Heroku, Docker; Solidity + web3 (to_blockchain)
